risk_factors.heading: Our operating results are impacted by global economic conditions and may fluctuate in the future due to a number of factors that could reduce our net sales and profitability.
risk_factors.quote: general economic, industry, public health or political conditions in the U.S. or internationally, including uncertain economic conditions in U.S., China and Europe, changes in geopolitical conditions, interest rates, persistent inflation, tariffs or instability in the banking sector;
